title: Character roster for a MOBA-like mobile game
author: MrTheWaffleKing
selftext:
Most of these characters originated as DND subclasses/PC races, but I'm trying to give them simple MOBA kits for a game that boils MOBA mechanics to their absolute basics to make for shorter mobile friendly matches.

First column is tanks with The Jailer and a Vitriol Diver.

Second is fighters with The Boulder and an Endothermic Construct.

Third is assassins with a generic reaper I'd like to reskin and make my own, and a Blade Elemental.

Fourth is casters with the Hexmage, Astral Warden, and Krackle (the pyromancer who blew up his own head but was too insane to die).

Fifth is supports with the Timekeeper's Wrath and Void Oculus.

\---------

Ultimately I'm super early into development process, I've only been generating still concept art and I've been working on game mechanics and ability kits in sheets.
